newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Aracruz Celulose 1996 net drops.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Aracruz Celulose 1996 net drops.

text.p: Brazil's Aracruz Celulose SA on Wednesday said its 1996 net profit fell to $128.5 million under generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) of the United States.
The pulp and paper maker's earnings compare with 1995 net profit of $386.1 million under U.S. GAAP.
Earnings per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) dropped to $0.5965 in 1996 from $1.7920 the previous year.
Under Brazilian GAAP, Aracruz Celulose's 1996 consolidated net profit fell to 47.5 million reais ($45.7 million) from 326.4 million reais ($313.8 million) the previous year.
Earnings per share fell to 0.0441 reais ($0.0424) in 1996 from 0.3030 reais ($0.2913).
The company's inflation-adjusted consolidated net profit fell to 79.37 million reais ($76.3 million) from 356.43 million reais ($342.7 million).
Earnings per share dropped to 0.0737 reais ($0.0708) from 0.3308 reais ($0.3180).
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
